text:
The purchaser is likely to prevail because the easement was appurtenant to the woman's house and passed automatically with the conveyance of that house, first to the man and then to the purchaser via the warranty deed. The man's failure to take actual possession and the purchaser's later learning of the easement do not defeat the recorded easement. The man's barricade does not extinguish the purchaser's right to use the path.
CONFIDENCE: 90
